pedagogicalRepair: Teacher preparation explicitly defers a general triangle inequality rule until the following lesson. Rich V2 L06 previously led with numerical inequalities. Now students construct, measure, overlay, explain why a 3,4,9 triangle cannot close; general proof is deferred to L07. The 3,4,5 independent worked example remains but uses physical hinged reasoning.
learnerTask: Use connected strips (or an independently implemented digital hinge) to draw two different quadrilaterals with sides 4,5,6,9 inches and measure every interior angle and the diagonal AC. Construct and annotate the 4,5,8 inch triangle, compare it with another student's model by overlay/rotation/reflection. Attempt 3,4,9 inch triangle and explain the visible gap. Submit measurements and original drawings for a teacher's human review.

criteria.description: Construct and label a genuine triangle and quadrilateral with assigned physical strip lengths; record measured angles and accurate separate drawings.
Construct two valid noncongruent 4/5/6/9-inch quadrilaterals, show a differing diagonal or angle and explain same side multiset does not imply unique shape.
Explain via physical matching why 4/5/8-inch triangles overlay up to rigid motion, while 3/4/9-inch strips cannot close into a nondegenerate triangle.
Use explicit units, drawing precision, measurement records and oral/written reasoning; distinguish source investigation from pre-emptive general inequality rule.

teacherOnlyRubric.scoring: Human teacher only; numeric side closure alone is insufficient, and teacher assessment is not integrated.
